user.title: Choose Login Method

login.title: Username / Password Login
login.description:
Enter the username and password of your Baidu account (the same account as the Xiaodu app).

BAIDUID (optional but recommended): visit baidu.com in your browser, press F12 -> Application -> Cookies, copy the value of the BAIDUID field (e.g. XXXX...:FG=1) and paste it below. This significantly improves success and avoids Baidu's SMS-verification risk control.

cookie.title: Cookie Login
cookie.description:
Enter the BDUSS Cookie value of your Xiaodu account.

How to get it:
1. Visit https://xiaodu.baidu.com/saiya/smarthome/index.html in your browser and log in
2. Press F12 to open DevTools -> Application -> Cookies
3. Find the BDUSS field, copy its value and paste it below
